newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi bans the smoking of the traditional water pipe in public places.
- Thailand and the United Arab Emirates private sector businessmen discuss setting up joint projects.
- Number of industrial establishments in Dubai rose to 737 in 1995, representing 13.9 billion dirhams ($3.8 bln) investment.
- Airlines hike ticket prices to take advantage of the exodus of people before a visa amnesty expires at the end of September.
